title: Associate Economic Affairs Officer
name: Tamara Persaud
duties: Research on sustainable development and disaster-related issues in the Caribbean, including climate change, resilience, natural resource management, and the SDGs (specific topics are quite broad providing flexibility). Servicing meetings, organizing workshops, providing technical support to governments, and writing reports and policy papers. Only English is required for this position in practice.
team_composition: 3 people in the unit at present. FRO is P4, one research assistant (G6) and a programme manager (G5), however a P3 and P4 are being recruited.
duty_station_assessment: Interesting and fun place to live. People are very open and friendly, especially to foreigners. Climate is sunny and tropical. Having a car is ideal (especially if you have a family) but I do not have one, and find the rideshare service safe and reliable as a single woman. Trinidad is not a developing country, so you can find many of the products and services you would typically find in the US. The crime problem here is very localized to specific areas (which are obvious), and I have not felt unsafe. This is a very affordable duty station.
comments: FRO will likely be changing soon, colleagues in team are great.
notes: Post holder may not be participating; this post may not be in the exercise.

title: Associate Public Information Officer
name: Dilshat Zhussupova
duties: Managing the website and social media, monitoring the media, organizing outreach events, producing outreach materials, coordinating translations (multiple Myanmar languages). Mission once or twice a year. A great role for becoming well-rounded in comms and working on a highly sensitive mandate. No year is truly the same, so there's plenty of room for growth and to take on new responsibilities over time.
duty_station_assessment: Geneva is lovely, especially in the summer.
comments: Teleworking 2x a week and really smart, friendly teams from investigative/legal backgrounds. The work is creative, challenging and rewarding, especially if you're interested in the world of international justice. You'll become very familiar with using secure systems of working and communication.

title: Associate Librarian
name: Xiaojie SUN
duties:
1. Implement UN Secretary-General's Data Strategy at UNOG entity level. (this includes a lot of details. New area and may create future opportunities)
2. Provide reference and advisory services on historical archives covering all pillars of the UN's work—human rights, development, and peacebuilding—since 1945.
3. Support the curation of exhibitions on multilateral history (mostly on human rights).
duty_station_assessment:
Excellent work-life balance in Geneva. 
Family friendly duty station. 
You will be impressed by Swiss perfectionism...
comments:
1. The real title for this post is Associate Information Management Officer. This may be updated. 
2. French is the main working language in my section, but expertise matters more than language.
3. All colleagues are much more experienced than you, and they are willing to coach you in every aspect of your professional life.

title: Associate Evaluation and Inspection Officer
name: Fernanda Verissimo Soule
duties:
Conduct system-wide reviews covering 28 UN organizations on specific management-related topics. Reviews last 12-18 months. Reports are directed to executive heads and governing and legislative bodies of the UN organizations. Daily work is very similar to research: gather information (documents, surveys, interviews), analyze (quali and quanti methods), draft a report. 
There might be internal projects as well, which are based on the office needs but also on each officer's skills and capabilities.
team_composition:
Project-based teams. Currently: 1 D2 (Inspector), 1 P2 (myself), 1 G6 (research assistant). 
FRO is a P5

title: Associate Programme Management Officer (will likely be listed as Associate Legal Officer in the compendium)
unit: Division for Ocean Affairs and the Law of the Sea
name: Laura Carew
duties:
Contribute to the development and implementation of the programme of work of the 'Regular Process for Global Reporting and Assessment of the State of the Marine Environment, including Socioeconomic Aspects':
-       Implementation of the Assessment and capacity development workshops 
-        Establishment of writing teams for the World Ocean Assessment
-        Support the drafting of the World Ocean Assessment
-        Implementation of outreach and engagement initiatives, including the enhancement of DOALOS’ social accounts
-        Performing other secretariat activities
-       Dissemination of key information from the World Ocean Assessment.

Assist in the preparation and servicing of intergovernmental meetings on oceans and the law of the sea.
team_composition: My team, the Regular Process secretariat, is located within the Division for Ocean Affairs and the Law of the Sea (DOALOS). My team consists of: D1 (SRO), P4 (FRO), 1 P3, 1 P2 (this post) and 1 G staff. There are no specific distinctions of responsibilities between P3 and P2 positions. You are free to take on initiatives or tasks to help the team.
comments: You do not need a legal background for this position, it is one of a handful of positions in this Divisions that is not a legal post. Due to budget issues, i was moved to an Associate Legal Officer position at the beginning of this year. The budget has since come through, but admin delays mean I have not yet been moved back to my actual post of Associate Programme Management Officer.

title: Associate Programme Management Officer
unit: Division for Ocean Affairs and the Law of the Sea
name: Akhmad Sani
duties:
This role is located within the Secretariat of the the Agreement under the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea on the Conservation and Sustainable Use of Marine Biological Diversity of Areas beyond National Jurisdiction (BBNJ Agreement).

Support the coordination of BBNJ capacity-building initiatives
•Support the development, implementation and evaluation of awareness-raising, capacity-building and technical assistance programme.
•Support the development of tools and materials for promoting a better understanding of the BBNJ Agreement and outreach and awareness-raising materials in cooperation with legal officers.
•Contribute to the design, planning, organization and implementation of workshops and webinars.
•Support the preparation of survey and needs assessment initiatives
•Support fund-raising activities and donor engagement, as needed, assist with project and grant proposals and contribute to the management of contributions and related reporting.

Capacity building and trust funds
•Provide support to the preparation and delivery of other capacity-building activities, as needed.
•Provide support to the management of trust funds, including fundraising and reporting, with a focus on the BBNJ trust fund.


Participate in the preparations for and servicing of intergovernmental meetings on oceans and the law of the sea
team_composition: P5 (SRO), P5 (ARO), P4 (FRO), P4 (ARO), P4 Legal Officer, P3 Legal Officer, and 1 G Staff.
duty_station_assessment: Plenty of things have been said about New York. I just want to add that if you have a family with kids, after 5 years living in the city, P2 salary might feel a bit tight to allow you to generate a significant saving unless your spouse also has a job.
comments: There are a few things that I need to explain about this position so please reach out to me if you are interested in this position.
